race.comment: HARD SHELL (4) gets his chance first-up from a four-month spell under new trainer Stirling Osland. Yet to fill a placing in eight starts but was competitive last prep in provincial races. Blinkers go on for this soft first-up target. Expect a bright return. POST MARK (12) settled midfield then made up good late ground to finish second on debut over 1280m at Muswellbrook. Draws a nice gate and the extra trip is right up his alley. Looks the big threat in a race of few chances. SILVER DREAM (13) travelled midfield and struggled to improve at her latest run over 1200m at Tamworth. Might be worth one more chance over a bit more ground third-up. DEKKA'S LATEST (2) led but tired to finish third when resuming over 1280m at Muswellbrook recently. Fitter for that run and may prove tough to peg back. That looks to be the race with HIDDEN DETAIL (5) next best, aided by the inside draw.
